extraction.tax_onetime_note: Provision for income taxes increased by $1.5 billion due to the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, comprising $2.0 billion from remeasurement of deferred tax assets and liabilities, $1.2 billion from deemed repatriation tax, offset by $1.7 billion impact on unrecognized tax benefits.
